column1: How often do you face the following situations:
Complete the questionnaire to get your total result
If your result falls between 2 and 3, you are good. The only suggestion we make is that you check your answers to be sure that you were sincere when answering.
If your result is located between 3 and 4, it would be good for you to review your work activity, set new priorities and think about making some changes
If your result is above 4, you are experiencing such wear and tear that you must necessarily do something about it.
A result of 5 indicates a serious condition and a need for immediate help.
